summary: A modern Scarborough dental studio appears to lose new patients to a 2021 footer, a stuffed page title and odd menu labels.

findings.cost: Five old years suggest the practice is not active online.
findings.fix: A footer that updates by itself.

findings.problem: The page title appears to run on with many keywords such as Cosmetic Dentist, Dental Implants, Toronto Invisalign and Scarborough Dentistry.
findings.cost: Search results cut it off and the long title looks spammy.
findings.fix: A short title with the practice name and suburb.

findings.problem: Menu labels such as hello, First and design safEty appear with odd casing.
findings.cost: Odd labels confuse new patients and look unfinished.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp appears, only a phone number and a book button.
findings.cost: Younger patients choose practices they can message in seconds.
findings.fix: WhatsApp or text booking on every page.
